content.short: Gagarin World is a multi-chain incubator and launchpad supporting TON through expert mentorship and IDOs.
content.description: Gagarin World is a prominent multi-chain incubator and decentralized launchpad that helps high-potential projects transition from initial ideation to a successful public launch. It provides expert mentorship, business development support, and access to a vast network of VCs and market makers. Gagarin World offers a tiered investment system for its community, allowing users to participate in exclusive IDOs and private rounds. By providing a bridge between the TON and EVM networks, Gagarin World enhances liquidity and visibility for the most ambitious projects in the ecosystem.
content.meta: Incubate and launch your TON project with Gagarin World. Discover IDOs on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
